author: Samsung
description:
Tomorrow takes shape long before it arrives. It begins with young people who dare to question what's possible.  

Samsung Solve for Tomorrow supports young innovators as they turn their ideas into action. Through mentorship and hands-on learning, they explore how technology can help tackle real-world challenges and develop meaningful solutions.  

Every attempt is an opportunity to learn, grow and move one step closer to creating positive change. 

Because when future generations grow, they shape a better world. 

#SolveForTomorrow #SolveAmbassador #TogetherForTomorrow #EnablingPeople #Samsung
title: Solve for Tomorrow: Our Shared Journey to Shape the Future | Samsung

#SmartThings #LocationBasedCare #FamilyCare

This is the official video guide on how to use SmartThings Family Care.👱‍♀️‍👱‍♂️

Wondering if your parents made it to a doctor's appointment today?👨‍⚕️
Location-Based Care lets you know when they arrive and when they leave.

Location-Based Care is a SmartThings Family Care feature that lets you register places like a doctor's office or pharmacy. Get notified when your parent arrives at or leaves those places, so you can stay informed about their day without asking every time.

Let's get started with the SmartThings app on your smartphone 😊
Try now: https://www.smartthings.com/applink?action=service&service_code=FAMILY_CARE&clear_task=false
title: SmartThings Family Care - Location based Care | Samsung

#SmartThings #CareOnCall #FamilyCare

This is the official video guide on how to use SmartThings Family Care.👨🏻‍👩🏻‍👧🏻‍👦🏻 

Start every call with the context you need 📞

Care on Call is a SmartThings Family Care feature that helps you check in on a parent who lives apart from you. When you call them from your Galaxy phone, a pop-up appears before the call connects, showing their first activity of the day, their most recent activity, and the local weather.

Let's get started with the SmartThings app on your smartphone 😊
Try now: https://www.smartthings.com/applink?action=service&service_code=FAMILY_CARE&clear_task=false
title: SmartThings Family Care - Care on Call | Samsung
